text: Landed in commit 198d603 as public AtomicFiles in worker (F[_]: Sync + total *Blocking forms). AMENDMENT to plan 2f's 'stays private[worker]': the sojourn spool runtime is the first external consumer, so the kernel is public API of scala-slurm-worker. Reconciled the three temp-then-rename copies on the strictest behavior (CREATE_NEW private temp, fsync force(true), ATOMIC_MOVE, no copy/delete fallback); claim(from,to) returns Claimed | AlreadyClaimed | SourceMissing | SourceNotRegular | AtomicMoveUnavailable | Io; direct suite covers 16-contender race, symlink refusal, restart idempotence, temp hygiene. FileWorkerEventSink's locked NDJSON append is out of scope (not a temp-rename write).
